Retail Assistant | Sylvia Park, Auckland

Part-time role (10 hours per week)

About the role:

Our busy Sylvia Park store is looking for a part-time Retail Assistant to join the successful Plainwear team. If you’re passionate about retail, love providing excellent customer experiences and enjoy being part of a fantastic group of people, this is the perfect chance for you!

What you will do:

Contribute to a customer service-focused atmosphere that is inviting for both customers and team members.
Ensure that our store's presentation and merchandising consistently meet high standards.
As the face of Plainwear, you'll educate and assist customers in discovering the right products to suit their needs.

We want to work with someone who has:

Previous experience in retail, customer service or hospitality, with enthusiasm and is hardworking.
We have a close-knit crew of retail staff so you'll have to work well with a team and have good time management.
Ideally, you'd have a well-developed sense of your own style; self-confidence and a genuine love for selling high quality basic apparel.
Be a fan of the brand and enjoy delivering a fantastic retail experience.
The right to live and work in New Zealand permanently.

Excellent benefits include:

Being part of an international growing company.
Competitive hourly rate and commission structure.
Quarterly clothing allowance so you can wear our gear.
Generous staff discount on all Plainwear apparel.
A positive, energetic and supportive work environment.
Real opportunity to build your career.
A strong focus on ethical and sustainable business practices.
Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).

About us:

Established in 2005 in Auckland, New Zealand, Plainwear has grown from humble beginnings in Central Auckland to now operate six distribution facilities and thirty retail locations across NZ, AU, US, UK and now the Netherlands.

As a company, we firmly believe that longer-lasting products are better for the environment. By creating exceptional quality garments built to last, we aim to reduce waste and encourage conscious consumption.

Whether it’s the products we make or people who work for us, it’s all the same. We’re super values driven and strive to be a company that helps people and the planet flourish as a result of what we do.

If you tick these boxes and want to work with a growing kiwi brand then apply now - Apply Now!
